thread:
Alex G: Hey team — starting onboarding for new inference project in asia-east2. Need quota bump + project approval. Will be serving Redwood Dedicated: estimate peak 20 A100 (a2-highgpu style), fallback L4s for cost tiers. Also need 25 static EIPs and VPC egress increase. Any blockers?
Priya S: @Alex G can you paste the project_id and the expected start date + duration? Need that for the request ticket. Also which machine family exactly (A100 80GB or 40GB)? :eyes: 
Alex G: project_id: rwinf-dedicated-asia, start: 2026-05-04, duration: ongoing (reserved pool). A100 80GB preferred, but we can accept 40GB if region capacity forces it. L4 count ~ 40 for burst fallback. EIPs: 25 static for NAT + load balancers. Egress target 12 Tb/month -> currently default too low.
Dan W: Copy. I'll open the GCP quota ticket and ping networking. Just need the cost center code and a short justification blurb.
Alex G: cost_center: infra-dedicated. Justification: "Dedicated inference pool for customer-facing latency-sensitive workloads; requires reserved A100 capacity in asia-east2 to meet latency SLOs. L4 fallback reduces unit cost during scale events. Static EIPs for predictable outbound IPs for partner allowlists."
Priya S: Thanks. Preflight I ran shows limited A100 availability in asia-east2 right now. If quota approved we may have placement delays. Recommend allowing asia-southeast1 as fallback. Also created a short checklist snippet you can attach to the request: 
```
- project: rwinf-dedicated-asia
- requested resources: 20 A100 (a2-highgpu-80g), 40 L4 (n2d-l4), 25 static external IPs
- egress: increase to 12 TB/month (currently 1 TB)
- network: VPC-SC approved, private-service-connect enabled
- start date: 2026-05-04
```
Dan W: Filing ticket now. Will request multi-zone placement and quota transfer option. Creating reference: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/projects/rwinf-dedicated-asia -> (link)
infra-bot: New quota request created: Q-78321. Assigned to Dan W. Link: https://go/redwood/q/Q-78321. Please add cost approval thread and attach the justification.
Li Chen: @Dan W can you include the estimated monthly spend so Finance can fast-track it? We need ballpark for 20 A100s + 40 L4 + egress + EIP costs.
Alex G: rough calc: A100 reserved pool amortized ~ $140k/month (committed), L4 burst ~ $18k/month, EIPs ~ $250/month, egress (12TB) ~ $1.6k/month. Total ~ $160k/month (estimate). I'll add line items to the ticket.
Ops Oncall: heads up — asia-east2 has a known maintenance window 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-12 (short notice). Recommend schedule onboarding before or after that window.
Dan W: Thanks. Adding maintenance note to the request and marking preferred start 2026-05-04 with fallback 2026-05-15 if we hit provisioning delays. Also asked GCP rep to check stock in region.
Finance Bot: Please include PO or billing contact for cost approval. Tagging @Finance for sign-off.
Alex G: billing_contact: ops-billing@redwood.ai. Added PO# TBD. Anything else?
Priya S: One more ask: attach a small acceptance test: sanity inference at 99th perc latency < 120ms on p90 traffic. If quota team wants perf evidence for justification attach our perf deck (link).
Alex G: Done. Attached perf deck and example deployment yaml to the ticket. Example snippet in case helpful: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  replicas: 4
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: model
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Dan W: Cool. I'll follow up once GCP confirms Q-78321. If they push capacity constraints we'll request asia-southeast1 as DR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
